name: Chrono Gladiator
summary:
They move when you move.

Step into the sand of a blood-soaked Roman arena as a lone gladiator. In Chrono Gladiator, time bends to your motion — when you stand still, the world freezes. When you strike, dodge, or step aside, your enemies move with you. Every swing of your blade is a decision, not a panic.

Read your opponent. Watch the incoming blade hang frozen in the air, choose your angle, and counter with perfect timing. This isn’t about swinging as fast as you can — it’s about moving smart. Pure single
